Package ch.colabproject.colab.api.model.link

Class StickyNoteLink

java.lang.Object
ch.colabproject.colab.api.model.link.StickyNoteLink
All Implemented Interfaces:
ColabEntity, WithDeletionStatus, WithPermission, WithTrackingData, WithWebsocketChannels, ch.colabproject.colab.generator.model.interfaces.WithId, ch.colabproject.colab.generator.model.interfaces.WithJsonDiscriminator, Serializable
@Entity public class StickyNoteLink extends Object implements ColabEntity, WithWebsocketChannels
Link to make an information accessible within a card.

The source of information can be either

  • a card
  • a card content
  • a resource
  • a document
Author:
sandra
